paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC as a function of generation temperature, comparing three methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis represents Temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 in linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 in linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL method is depicted by a yellow line with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1, rising to a peak of 75.0 at 0.2, then declining to 67.0 at 0.3, before increasing again to 72.0 at 0.5, then fluctuating with a final value of 73.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY method is shown by a red line with star markers and a solid line, beginning at 75.0 at 0.1, peaking at 80.0 at 0.8, then declining slightly to 78.0 at 0.9, and ending at 80.0 at 1.0. The SFT method is represented by a teal line with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at 75.0 at 0.1, decreasing to 73.0 at 0.2, then rising to 75.0 at 0.3, before declining to 70.0 at 0.5, then increasing to 75.0 at 0.6, and ending at 74.0 at 1.0.
